description: Update a draft or scheduled in-app campaign. Only the fields you pass change; message fields merge over the stored message. Live campaigns can't be edited: stop and duplicate them instead.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

endsAt.description: ISO 8601 time the campaign ends: after it nobody new gets it and it leaves every feed that still has it. Null: runs until stopped.

message.description: The in-app message, same fields as an in-app sequence step: kind ("message" default, or "card"), format ("modal" default, "banner", "fullscreen", "html"), position (banners "top"/"bottom", modals "bottom"/"center"), eyebrow, title, body, imageUrl, imagePlacement ("top"/"background"), buttons (up to 2: {label, action: "open_url"|"dismiss"|"request_push_permission", url}), data (string map for the app), style ({preset} plus overrides), pinned (cards), expiresAfterDays (how long a contact keeps it after first receiving it; default: until the campaign ends), html and showCloseButton (format "html"). Merge tags like {{firstName}} are filled per contact when they receive it. On update, the fields you pass are merged over the stored message; clear imageUrl, position, imagePlacement, expiresAfterDays, style, html or showCloseButton with null, eyebrow with "", buttons with [] and data with {}.

priority.description: Order among messages waiting in the app at the same time; higher first. Default medium (same as sequence messages).

targetLists.description: Audience, same shape as campaign targetLists: {"type":"all"}, {"type":"lists","listIds":[...]}, {"type":"segment","segmentId":"..."}, or {"type":"rules","include":[...],"exclude":[...]}. Each contact is checked against it when their app fetches its feed while the campaign is live, so people who join the audience later get it too.

name: update_in_app_campaign
